name: source-runner-lifecycle
goal: Source profiling observes actual execution with bounded overhead while preserving foreign-process startup, type erasure, declaration collection and explicit benchmark boundaries.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Full root profiling run4d26 completed930pass6fail25skip. Confirmed loader eagerly loads TypeScript in foreign processes, retains type-only value imports, and traces declaration inventory. Unbounded observer calls also perturb nested command timing. No test or performance limit is being relaxed.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Extend standardized source-runner lifecycle and sampling categories: foreign startup and registered imports, type/live side-effect import parity, declaration transforms versus runtime evidence, benchmark child environment, and bounded sync/async observations with original operation counts and error values. Existing registration, pinned tools, late cleanup and recorded-values tests remain unchanged.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed1c5b852ca red2c3e6961aaf7: six of seven new lifecycle/sampling cases fail for actual loader/observer behavior, while the registered-import positive case passes. Lint passes on the strengthened tests.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Use a lightweight Bun hook with lazy, cycle-safe compiler loading; trim type-only imports; separate declaration collection; remove only the owned preload in benchmark children. Limit automatic observations to first10successful calls with async slot release; never replay or suppress business calls.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: All34 focused profiling/runner cases pass together. Types, lint, audit and registry pass. The original five failed files and broader checks remain to be replayed with evidence requested; no original limit or assertion was changed.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired red6c4d204d at1c5b852ca and green93bfd36b at694acd350 pass all seven unchanged lifecycle/sampling cases in the same environment. Intermediate49f6fdd3 failed evidence startup and is not a green checkpoint.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The isolated old loader fails six lifecycle/sampling cases while registered-import behavior passes. Repaired source passes all seven. The five original failed files also pass unchanged with profiling enabled:20tests on694acd350, including original timing and type-entry guards.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
